content.title: Wendy’s Frosty® Key Tags | $3 for a Year of Free Jr. Frosty Treats
content.text: How do you get a Wendy’s Frosty Key Tag? Both physical Key Tags that go on your keychain and digital Key Tags that live in your Wendy’s app are available for purchase from mid-November to mid-February, or until supplies last. Physical tags can be purchased in-restaurant, at the drive-thru, via a kiosk, or through our app or website. A digital tag can be ordered through our app or website. Upon purchase, you should receive your Key Tag as a mobile offer in your MyWendy’s account. While you may purchase a digital key tag multiple times, only one Digital Frosty Key can be applied per account. However, any additional Digital Frosty Key Tags purchased will still benefit the Dave Thomas Foundation for Adoption. The digital key tags are not able to be purchased and gifted at this time. How long are Key Tags good for? Do they expire? They’re good for a full year. Key Tags purchased November – December will expire on December 31st of the following year. Are Key Tags available at all locations? Most, but not all. Frosty Key Tags are available for sale at all participating Wendy’s locations in the U.S. during the promotional period while supplies last.. If a location has chosen to participate, you will see physical and digital Key Tags as an option under the “Give Something Back” menu category. Are Key Tags available through delivery? Yes, you can purchase key tags for delivery in the Wendy’s app during the promotional period. Frosty Key Tags are not available to purchase through third-party delivery providers. Can I buy Key Tags in bulk? I want to buy Frosty Key Tags as gifts. Can I give a digital key tag? Frosty Key Tags make a great gift! It’s not possible to purchase a digital Frosty Key Tag for someone else’s account, but physical tags make terrific presents for your neighbor, teacher, friends, and family. And, they’re an especially sweet treat since the funds support foster care adoption.
